name: NoteGPT
summary: AI study and work assistant that summarises YouTube videos, PDFs and audio, and generates podcasts, slides and flashcards.
description: An all-in-one AI assistant for students, teachers, researchers and professionals: YouTube/PDF/Word/audio summaries, transcripts with speaker separation and translation, AI podcasts with voice cloning, slide and spreadsheet generation, flashcard and quiz makers, an AI image/video generator and a Chrome extension. A free tier exists; Pro, Unlimited and Max plans add premium credits, and a REST API exposes transcription, summary, podcast, mind-map and flashcard endpoints.
contains: summarises YouTube videos, PDFs, Word documents and audio
AI podcast generator with voice cloning and multi-language voices
generates slides, spreadsheets, images, audio and videos from one agent
flashcard maker and quiz generator from documents, video or audio
Chrome extension for YouTube and Udemy summarisation
REST API for transcriptions, summaries, podcasts, mind maps and flashcards
plans: free tier, Pro $9/mo, Unlimited $19.92/mo, Max $69/mo (annual saves 30%)
